---


Fixed the compiler error by extracting the complex Map content into separate computed properties:

1. **`mapContent`** — Contains all the Map annotations and route drawing logic
2. **`routeContent(for:)`** — Handles the route drawing logic separately

This breaks the complex expression into smaller sub-expressions, making it easier for the Swift compiler to type-check. The code should compile without the "unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time" error.

The functionality remains the same; the structure is just organized differently to help the compiler.

Refactored to break up the complex expression:

1. **`baseMapView`** — Contains the Map with its content (annotations and route)
2. **`mapWithModifiers`** — Applies all modifiers to the base map view
3. **`userMarkerContent`** and **`deviceMarkerContent`** — Extracted marker views
4. **`topOverlayContent`** — Extracted overlay content

This splits the complex expression into smaller, type-checkable pieces. The Map content is inlined in `baseMapView`, and the modifiers are separated into `mapWithModifiers`.

The code should compile without the "unable to type-check this expression in reasonable time" error. If issues persist, we can extract the route drawing logic into a helper closure.
